hero.subtitle: We connect hosts, affiliates and travelers in a referral platform that turns word-of-mouth into real commissions from vacation bookings.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: GYDI was born in 2024 with a clear vision:
story.p1Bold: democratize access to the real estate market
story.p1End: and create income opportunities for people around the world.
story.p2Start: We observed that Airbnb solved visibility, but left a huge gap: no one was helping hosts activate their own referral network. On the other hand, thousands of people wanted to earn money recommending accommodations, but had no tools to do so.
story.p2Bold: We saw the opportunity to unite both worlds.
story.p3End2: . Hosts get more bookings. Affiliates earn commissions. Everyone wins.
story.p4End: and hundreds of listed properties, we are building the future of the digital real estate market.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Create real income opportunities for anyone, connecting hosts with rental properties and affiliates with travelers through a transparent and fair referral platform.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be the largest rental property referral network in Latin America, where Airbnb hosts and affiliates collaborate to generate real income in a simple and transparent way.

why.title: Why Choose GYDI?
why.subtitle: We stand out for our commitment to excellence and transparency
why.f1Desc: Protected transactions and encrypted data. Your security is our priority.
why.f2Desc: Up to 10% commission on referrals. The most competitive rates in the market.
why.f3Desc: More than 500 active affiliates worldwide generating income with us.
why.f4Desc: Dedicated team available 24/7 to answer your questions and help you grow.
